$comment: Civilization laws (docs/proposals/civilization-laws.md): each village keeps a code of them (settlement.code); the first option of each is the default (today's game). kingdom: the capital sets it for every member. mood: how people feel living under it (the Mood phase).

options.name: Normal
options.about: People work and rest as they need.

options.name: Long hours
options.about: People work later into the night and get more done, but go to bed tired.

options.name: Curfew
options.about: No outdoor work at night (22:00-06:00): people stay in, safer from wolves and monsters.

options.name: None
options.about: People eat their fill.

options.name: Rationed
options.about: Smaller meals: hunger falls a fifth more slowly, but work is a tenth slower.

options.name: Free
options.about: Children study or forage as they like.

options.name: Compulsory
options.about: Children study in school hours and never forage then.

options.name: Child labour
options.about: Children also haul and farm, but learn nothing.

options.name: None
options.about: Only those the village arms carry weapons.

options.name: Militia
options.about: Every fit adult is armed and counts as a fighter, even in peace.

options.name: Free
options.about: Hunters go out when meat is wanted.

options.name: Restricted
options.about: Hunting only when food runs low (under 3 days).

options.name: Banned
options.about: No hunting, except packs that attack the village.

options.name: Free
options.about: Any grown tree may be felled.

options.name: Protected
options.about: No grown tree within 12 tiles of the village centre is felled (building sites are still cleared).

civLaw.name: Borders
civLaw.about: Dealings with villages outside the kingdom.

options.name: Open
options.about: Trade and traders come and go.

options.name: Closed
options.about: No trade with, or traders from, villages outside the kingdom; illness does not travel in with traders.

civLaw.name: Tithe
civLaw.about: What members owe the kingdom's capital.

options.name: None
options.about: Members owe nothing.

options.name: Tithe
options.about: Every 10 days each member sends a tenth of its spare goods to the capital.

options.name: Usual
options.about: Fines and seizures as usual.

options.name: Lenient
options.about: Half the attention to smuggling, half the seizures.

options.name: Harsh
options.about: Twice the attention and seizures: smugglers keep away.
